params.name: Travellers often open their itineraries
params.text: Travellers often open their itineraries in places with no connectivity — airports, trains, foreign networks. Today the app needs a live request to render a trip, which drives 18% of our 1-star reviews. This page describes a local-first sync engine for itineraries, tickets and maps.
